owner rulings: 2026-11-08-haloander-decisions.md item 2, board_rule.txt, HANDOFF/KEAN.md D-20261125-board-cover-date
reasoning: Identity confirmed: 20 FR 5911, signed by Eisenhower at the White House on 1955-08-13; the NMB report of Emergency Board No. 112 (NMB Case A-4712) names EO 10630 dated August 13, 1955, the New York Central System, Lines East and the Order of Railway Conductors and Brakemen. The transmittal letter's 'August 16, 1955' is the FR publication date and does not affect identity. Inventory complete: the board clause (create, investigate, report within thirty days) with recitals, and the no-change sentence; no other command. Every cited text and both held PDFs re-hash correctly and every quoted span matches its bytes at the stated offsets. The letter's date line reads 'September 1~, 1955' with the day partly unreadable, so the clean cover date SEPTEMBER 14, 1955 is used under D-20261125-board-cover-date and disclosed; the legible part of the letter agrees. The judgment reason's 'no letter of transmittal date line was found' slightly misdescribes a line that was found but is partly unreadable; the rationale's 'unreadable or not found' covers it and the outcome is unaffected (same treatment as EO 10050 and EO 10067 in the blind review). The report is dated two days after the order's 30-day deadline (1955-09-12). A full pdftotext pass over all 20 PDF pages finds no extension, stipulation, supplemental report or reconvening wording; the only pages without a text layer are pages 2, 4 and 6, blank versos between roman-numbered pages I, III and V. Under board_rule.txt the report deadline is never an end, so the late report raises no earlier end, and the claim's statement that the screen found no extension is accurate. The claim would be clearer if it said the report came after the deadline with no recorded extension, but nothing it states is wrong. Arithmetic: 1955-09-14 + 30 days = 1955-10-14 (inclusive; exclusive 1955-10-13), correct; whole-order end 1955-10-14 is the latest clause end and agrees across the structured fields, judgment reasons and rationale. EO 12553 lists 10630 in its revocation table and has no savings wording; the only OFR note is 'Revoked by: EO 12553'; the cruden number search (4 hits, all the order's own printing or the report) finds no amending, extending or revoking order. Packet dossier fingerprint equals claim_kit.dossier_sha256. Savings and searches adequate.
